record.reason: The method executes all 5! retrieved-document permutations to collect final-layer states and clusters them, then decodes representatives. Its contribution is RAG answer stability/accuracy via permutation analysis and DPO, not reducing normal LLM serving cost; the 120-permutation pass is itself substantial inference work.
record.title: Stable-RAG: Mitigating Retrieval-Permutation-Induced Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
